claims.quote: Conservative treatment is possible because of children's bone remodeling potential.
claims.statement_ru: Консервативное лечение переломов возможно у детей благодаря потенциалу ремоделирования костей.

claims.quote: In case of displaced fractures, when a closed reduction can be done in the emergency room (ER), this avoids general anesthesia, hospitalization and the associated costs.

claims.quote: When reduction is done in the ER, the complication and secondary displacement rates are not higher, although surgeon experience and specific procedural training appear to be crucial.

claims.quote: An ideal fracture is one that requires a simple one-shot reduction maneuver with stable reduction after immobilization.
